scenes.heading: How this video was made
lines: A video about X_eTaL, scheduled by X_eTaL.
No timeline editor. No keyframes. Data and arrays.

scenes.heading: 1. A lesson is data
lines: Each scene is a heading, some lines and a length in seconds:
The whole video is one file: lessons/making-of/lesson.json

scenes.heading: 2. X_eTaL computes the schedule
lines: Seconds become frames. Where each scene starts is one running sum.
The bar below is that array, drawn.

scenes.heading: 3. Every frame knows its place
lines: These numbers are live: this is frame {{f}} of {{total}}.
All {{total}} frames are computed at once, as arrays.

scenes.heading: 4. Motion is arithmetic
lines: Each line's fade-in is a column of that table.
Three curves over this scene: linear, in-out cubic, out cubic.

scenes.heading: 5. Frames, then a file
lines: A script draws one picture per frame from those numbers.
ImageMagick makes {{total}} PNGs. ffmpeg encodes them:
